Goa BJP MLA Jennifer Monserrate Dies at 56

Jennifer Monserrate, a three-term Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) for the Taleigao constituency and a former state minister in Goa, has passed away at the age of 56. Her death was reported by multiple news outlets.
